subject: ACE opportunity triage & PDM/PSM intro for Quantify AI
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Claire Moreno <claire.moreno@quantify.ai>, Derek Liu <derek.liu@quantify.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACE opportunity triage & PDM/PSM intro for Quantify AI

Hi Claire / Derek —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our notes, Quantify AI is a good fit for an AWS ACE co-sell path, and I want to get us moving on two parallel tracks so we hit listing/enablement without slowing procurement. Quick plan below:

- ACE registration: I'll share the ACE intake checklist and the minimal assets AWS needs to validate the listing.
- PDM/PSM intro: can we schedule a 30-min PDM intro to map go-to-market and a short PSM technical scoping session (30–45m) to validate capacity and integration workstreams.
- Procurement: please share your target PO/contract timing and any security/compliance artifacts we should surface to AWS early (SOC2, data residency statements).

Next steps I propose: Claire to confirm procurement timeline and who owns billing; we (Laura + Aditya) will coordinate ACE checklist and PDM/PSM calendar invites. I attached our initial requirements spreadsheet to speed intake.

[attachment: Quantify_ACE_Requirements.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Thanks — looking forward to lining this up.

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

From: Claire Moreno <claire.moreno@quantify.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Derek Liu <derek.liu@quantify.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACE opportunity triage & PDM/PSM intro for Quantify AI

Connor —

Thanks, that sounds great. Attaching our procurement timeline and draft internal SOO so you can see the milestone dates. High level: we plan to have a PO approved by mid-August (target 8/17) and need the ACE listing complete before the sales kickoff on 9/1.

For the PDM intro, please include whoever owns the ACE listing process from Redwood and your technical PSM who can speak to deployment/throughput expectations for our training pipeline. We expect to run slightly longer sequences (avg 2k tokens) and will want to confirm batching/latency targets on g4dn/g5 instances.

Two questions for you now:
1) Rough ETA for ACE listing once we submit the intake (weeks?)
2) Any redlines in your standard MOA we should prep for procurement?

Attached: Quantify_Procurement_Timeline.docx

Claire Moreno
Head of Cloud Partnerships | Quantify AI
claire.moreno@quantify.ai | +1 617-555-0234

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Claire Moreno <claire.moreno@quantify.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Derek Liu <derek.liu@quantify.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Jul 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACE opportunity triage & PDM/PSM intro for Quantify AI

Claire —

Appreciate the timeline — that lines up well. A few concrete details to keep momentum:

- ACE listing ETA: based on recent ACE flows, once AWS receives a complete intake and product assets it typically takes 2–4 weeks for the partner listing to be approved and turned into a co-sell opportunity. We'll push for the shorter end but need a complete intake.
- MOA redlines: our standard MOA is fairly straightforward; the procurement team sometimes asks for a limitation of liability carveout and a narrow confidentiality clause. Happy to share the current draft and flag any provisions we expect procurement to ask about.
- PDM/PSM meetings: Proposed slots — PDM intro: Tue Aug 1, 10:00–10:30 PT; PSM scoping: Wed Aug 2, 11:00–11:45 PT. Aditya will lead PDM and Laura will handle ACE listing artifacts with you. Please confirm availability and who on your side will be the technical lead for the PSM session.

I attached a short ACE readiness checklist to help you assemble the intake quickly. Also linking our HubSpot deal for reference and the ACE listing guide.

[attachment: ACE_Readiness_Checklist.pdf]

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/56789
ACE listing guide: https://aws.amazon.com/partners/ace/listing/quantify-ai

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Moreno <claire.moreno@quantify.ai>, Derek Liu <derek.liu@quantify.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Aug 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: ACE opportunity triage & PDM/PSM intro for Quantify AI

Connor / Laura —

Confirmed: I've scheduled the PDM intro with Claire for Tue Aug 1 at 10:00 PT and the PSM scoping for Wed Aug 2 at 11:00 PT. Invites have been sent to Claire, Derek, Connor, and Laura.

Status notes:
- I uploaded the MOA draft to DocuSign for internal routing and shared a preview with Quantify (link below). Expect procurement feedback early next week; I'll flag any unusual redlines.
- Laura: I'll need the ACE intake packet completed and the product assets (logo, short description, usage patterns) by Mon Jul 31 EOD to hit the 2–4 week timeline.
- Claire / Derek: please confirm the technical attendee for the PSM session (name + email) so we can dial into sequence/throughput specifics.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/drive/signed-moA-56789
Attached: Signed_MOA_draft.pdf (placeholder for routing; final sign will follow procurement)

Thanks — looking forward to driving this over the finish line.

Aditya Rao
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199
